primitives.name: Composite Team Rating
primitives.verbatim_quote: Una nota del 1 al 10" composite team rating (EPA + success rate + pressure summarized into one 1–10 figure), with ATAQUE and DEFENSA sub-ratings; all 32 teams.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'NOTA': 'dimensionless score from 1 to 10', 'EPA': 'expected points added per play (dimensionless)', 'Success Rate': 'percentage (0–100%)', 'Pressure Rate': 'percentage (0–100%)', '\\alpha, \\beta, \\gamma': 'normalization coefficients'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear combination of normalized metrics with fixed weights; sub-rating components are independent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Valid for full-season aggregate data with 10+ games.

layer2.mapping: GSI-derived probabilistic team strength model using EPA, success rate, and pressure as latent variables.
layer2.telemetry: Observed team performance metrics from X posts.

primitives.name: Personnel Usage Comparison
primitives.verbatim_quote: 11 / 12 / 21 personnel usage rates, 2026 season-to-date vs 2025, for the 21 teams with new offensive coordinators (63 rows): TEAM | OC | '25 % | '26 % | +/- (pp).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\Delta_{\\text{personnel}}': 'percentage point change', '\\text{Usage}_{2026}': 'usage rate in 2026 (0–100%)', '\\text{Usage}_{2025}': 'usage rate in 2025 (0–100%)'}
primitives.assumptions: Usage rates are comparable across seasons and teams; changes reflect coaching influence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Applicable to teams with new OCs and sufficient sample size (>10 games).

layer2.mapping: GSE mapping of personnel shifts to strategic state transitions in offensive execution.
layer2.telemetry: Quarterback and receiver alignment data from X posts.

primitives.name: Quarterback Efficiency Leaderboard
primitives.verbatim_quote: QB position tab, top 10 as shown in the post image (NOTA | DROPBACKS | EPA/DROPBACK | ÉXITO EN DROPBACK % | PASES AL OBJETIVO % | PRESIONES → SACK %): Geno Smith 9.3 ...
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{EPA/DB}': 'expected points added per dropback (dimensionless)', '\\text{Total EPA}': 'total expected points added (dimensionless)', '\\text{Dropbacks}': 'number of dropbacks (unitless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Dropbacks are accurately counted; EPA is normalized by play count.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Valid for players with ≥50 dropbacks in the window.

layer2.mapping: GSI-derived QB performance index using EPA per dropback and success metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Player-level EPA and dropback counts from X posts.

reasoning_traces.think:
The three sovereign primitives form a triadic system: (1) Composite Team Rating integrates EPA, success rate, and pressure into a scalar metric; (2) Personnel Usage Comparison quantifies strategic evolution through usage rate deltas; (3) Quarterback Efficiency Leaderboard normalizes EPA by dropbacks to assess individual QB performance. These primitives are dual in that they map both macro and micro performance to a shared dimensional space. Failure modes include overfitting due to small sample sizes, misalignment of metrics (e.g., pressure vs. EPA), and temporal drift in personnel usage. The system assumes stationarity in metric definitions and consistent data capture across sources.
